title: EHEYCIGA XL Large Size Removable Washable Waterproof Orthopaedic Bed, Memory Foam Sofa for Dogs, Grey, 44 x 32

reviews.title: Good quality
reviews.body: Very comfortable for a large dog, you get exactly what’s on the picture - it works a treat!
reviews.author: Joseph Meissner

reviews.title: Great quality
reviews.body: Very comfortable! Super soft and easy to clean. Has perfect stuffing and easy to put together. The shape is perfect and our dog loves it. Comes in many sizes. The only bed our dog hasn’t chewed on. Our cats like it too!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 11 July 2026
reviews.author: Tina

reviews.title: Not as described
reviews.body: This bed is not as pictured.The raised sides are not tightly filled. They are stuffed loosely and look limp even after a week. The cover is also not removable from the raised section meaning when you remove the cover you have to wash the loose stuffing.The bed looks cheap and nasty.Really disappointed.
reviews.author: Julie G

reviews.title: It looks cheap and nasty, not worth the money
reviews.body: Poor quality material. Not worth the money
reviews.author: Karen

reviews.title: Extra large bed really is
reviews.body: I have never bought a dog bed before. This is a review for the extra large bed. I have 8 large dogs. Two 80 lb. dogs can fit on this bed. Or a 120 lb. dog that likes to stretch out and not share.The item came with the bed rolled up and vacuum sealed as well as the foam insert. The bed fully unzips for easy placement of the foam insert. There is a foam edge around the border of the bed (except the front) where the dog can rest their head.This product is a solid 5 stars. I had ordered two of them (to see what kind of quality they were) and have two more waiting to be purchased. My dogs love and take turns laying on them.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 10 July 2026
reviews.author: Jeffrey
